style: An oil painting in the manner of nineteenth-century academic history painting: rich palette, dramatic chiaroscuro, visible brushwork, painterly and cinematic, 16:9. England and France in 1775: tricorn hats, greatcoats, knee-breeches, buckled shoes, candle and lantern light, no modern objects.  One single painting that fills the whole 16:9 frame edge to edge. Absolutely no text, lettering, captions, signature, monogram, watermark, border, frame or black bars anywhere. Bodies, arms and objects never pass through doors, walls or each other.

people.george: King George III of England in 1775: thirty-seven, a heavy jaw, full pale face, powdered wig, scarlet and ermine robes
people.charlotte: Queen Charlotte of England in 1775: thirty-one, a plain face, powdered hair, a court gown of white and gold
people.louis: King Louis XVI of France in 1775: twenty-one, a large heavy jaw, plump, powdered wig, blue velvet and ermine robes with gold fleurs-de-lis
people.marie: Queen Marie Antoinette of France in 1775: nineteen, a fair, delicate face, high powdered hair with feathers, a pale silk court gown

beats.text: Two cities in 1775 side by side in one wide painting, divided by a narrow sea: on the left London under a bright sky, St Paul's dome above the Thames crowded with ships; on the right Paris under a dark storm, the towers of Notre-Dame and the Seine. Light on one side, gloom on the other. Wide view.

Two thrones in one grand painting: on the left the King and Queen of England seated in state; on the right the King and Queen of France seated in state, a gilded palace hall behind each pair, courtiers bowing. The kings both have large jaws. Calm, complacent, splendid.

London 1775, night: an eager crowd of curious Londoners packed into a narrow dark lane in front of a shabby old house in Cock Lane, holding candles and lanterns, peering up at a lit upper window where a ghost is said to rap; gentlemen in tricorns, women in hoods. Wide view.

France 1775, a muddy town street in heavy rain: a procession of monks in dirty brown habits passes under dripping banners while townspeople kneel in the mud; one young man of nineteen stands apart, not kneeling, and soldiers in blue coats turn to seize him. Grey light, dread.

beats.text: A dark French forest in 1775: tall old trees, some marked with a white chalk cross by the woodman; at the edge of the wood, under the eaves of a poor farmhouse, rude wooden carts spattered with mud, pigs snuffing about them and hens roosting on them. Ominous, quiet, cold blue light.

An English highway at night in 1775: masked highwaymen on horseback with pistols stop a coach on a lonely heath; the passengers stand by the coach with raised hands, a lantern lit; moonlight through clouds. Wide view.

beats.text: Turnham Green near London, 1775, by day: the Lord Mayor of London in his scarlet robes and gold chain stands beside his gilded state coach while a single bold highwayman on horseback points a pistol at him; his whole retinue of footmen and attendants stands stock still, robbed in plain sight. Satirical, bright, absurd.

The great road out of London toward Dover at dusk in late 1775: a long, empty, muddy road over a dark heath under a vast darkening sky, a single mail coach far off with its lamps lit, the first lights of a town behind. Quiet, wide, foreboding.
